question.problem: What is the trace in the $yz$-plane of the ellipsoid $\frac{{x}^{2}}{8}+\frac{(y+1)^{2}}{6}+\frac{(z-1)^{2}}{12}=1?$
question.worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $yz$-plane, we substitute $x=0$ into the equation of the ellipsoid:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{0}^{2}}{8}+\frac{(y+1)^{2}}{6}+\frac{(z-1)^{2}}{12}=1 \\ \frac{(y+1)^{2}}{6}+\frac{(z-1)^{2}}{12}=1 \\ \frac{(y+1)^{2}}{(\sqrt{6})^{2}}+\frac{(z-1)^{2}}{(2\sqrt{3})^{2}}=1\end{aligned}
$$

This gives us the equation of the ellipse with semi-axes $\sqrt{6}$ and $2\sqrt{3},$ centered at $(-1,1)$ in the $yz$-plane.
